root_idea.summary: The root centers on breadth and the side or surface of a thing, and extends to turning one’s side away, overlooking, and contact between surfaces such as the palms.
root_idea.development: Physical meanings of width, side, and surface underlie expressions for turning away from an offense, passing beyond it, and related constructions of facing or joining hands.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the verbal noun صَفْح.

senses.definition: To turn away from someone or something, leave it, or disregard it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with عن for turning away from a person, affair, or matter; Quranic imperative and imperfect forms express commands or injunctions to turn away.

senses.definition: To turn away from an offense without reproach; to forgive.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with عن when the object is a crime, sin, fault, or offense. This is a stronger form of overlooking than merely remitting a penalty, emphasizing gracious forbearance.

senses.definition: Forbearance that leaves an offense without reproach; forgiveness or gracious overlooking.
senses.usage_conditions: In الصَّفْحُ الْجَمِيلُ, the noun denotes beautiful or gracious forbearance from an offense.

senses.definition: Turning aside or disregarding; passing over something rather than continuing to address it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction ضَرْبُ الذِّكْرِ صَفْحًا, it expresses turning the reminder aside or passing beyond the page or record on which a matter is noted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, ewe, or she-goat: to cease yielding milk, so that its milk goes away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I use describing loss of milk; a she-camel that has lost its young is also included.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a dog: to spread or stretch out its forelegs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the posture of a dog extending its forelegs toward something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike someone with the side or flat of a sword rather than its edge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is construed with the sword as the instrument and the side or breadth of the blade as the striking surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn a petitioner away, refuse a request, or deny someone what was sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively, including with a person and the thing he requested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported contrary extension of the transitive Form I verb, opposite in result to refusing a request.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a drink of any beverage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical use is reported without restriction on the kind or time of the beverage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make camels pass by a watering trough, apparently to water them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction صَفَحَ الإِبِلَ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing broad or wide; of a sword, to forge it broad and elongated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative or intensive use, especially of the shape of a sword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clap the hands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Synonymous in this use with صَفَّقَ; the clapping may be described as striking one hand against the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hand-taking or shaking hands by placing one person’s hand or palm in another’s.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional act of meeting and salutation, involving palms or hands placed together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A face-to-face meeting, or a meeting in which one turns the side of the face toward the other; also a sudden or unexpected encounter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression لَقِيَهُ صِفَاحًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sword: to invert or reverse it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV sword use, associated with turning the blade in its orientation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike with the side or flat of a sword rather than its edge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV alternative to the corresponding transitive Form I sword construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To examine carefully by inspecting sides, pages, faces, or details; to inspect people or look into an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of turning through a book page by page, examining people one by one or their faces, and investigating a matter or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take one another’s hands or shake hands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI use describing mutual hand-taking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of eyelids: to close together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in the expression تَصَافُحُ الأَجْفَانِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or beg someone to forgive an offense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X takes the offense as the object of the request for forgiveness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side, lateral portion, outward part, face, or surface of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the sides of a person, animal, mountain, sword, paper or book, hand, scapula, and other objects; the exact physical referent is supplied by context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excessive width of the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical description of the forehead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show someone one’s side openly, hence to display open enmity or reveal a concealed deed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of أَبْدَى لَهُ صَفْحَتَهُ; the hostile or revelatory interpretation depends on context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excessive width or flatness in the side of a horse’s cheek.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conformation regarded as undesirable in horses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who habitually turns aside others’ offenses and forgives; as an epithet of God, the Very Forgiving. It can also mean generous because generosity includes forgiving injury.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal or divine epithet; the generosity sense is explained through the connection between forgiveness and generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who turns away from someone or forsakes his society, as though giving him only her side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A gender-specific lexical use explicitly reported for the feminine referent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything made flat and broad or wide, especially an expanded solid or metal plate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or generic noun; a single piece may be expressed with the feminine form صَفِيحَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for Heaven, understood as the expanded or solid upper expanse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized traditional designation derived from the notion of an expanded solid surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A broad, flat slab or plate, including a wide stone, plank, board, thin stone placed over a grave, or broad sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term applies to broad flat materials and to a broad sword; its plural can denote boards, slabs, or swords according to context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of the principal broad bones of the skull.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use referring to the frontal, occipital, or parietal bones.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The face or surface of a broad thing; also the outer skin or cuticle of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A surface sense extended to the exterior skin of the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Camels whose humps have become large enough to occupy the whole back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural or collective descriptive use, likening the large, hard humps to broad stones.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel, ewe, or she-goat whose milk is going away; also a she-camel that has lost its young and consequently its milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial description of the animal’s loss of milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a traditional expression, one who puts forth the cheek or inclines to one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression contrasts not lifting the head with putting forth the cheek or leaning to one side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man excessively wide in the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival anatomical description derived from صَفَح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide or broad; applied especially to a sword or other thing, and to a broad or specially shaped head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Of a head, the description includes compressed sides near the temples, projecting forehead or occiput, or fore and hind parts projecting; these are reported physical specifications of the head shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a nose: straight in the bone, with the bone even with the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical description of the nose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a face: smooth, soft, and beautiful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of facial appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sword: inclined, bent, inverted, or reversed; turned onto its edge when striking or inclined when being sheathed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the sword’s orientation or movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a believer’s heart: inclined toward the truth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in which the heart’s side is imagined as placed upon the truth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a heart: turned away from the truth, insincere or harboring rancor, or double-faced between believers and unbelievers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use reported with divergent traditional interpretations, including a heart combining faith and hypocrisy or falling short in religious duty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of the sixth arrow used in the game of maysir.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term of the traditional arrow game.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who strikes with the side or face of a sword rather than its edge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The instrument is explicitly the sword and the striking surface its flat side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword, especially a broad or wide sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural مُصَفَّحَات is used for swords; the broadness is associated with their forging.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an alternative reading of a poetic passage, women clapping their hands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a reported alternative interpretation of the poetic plural form and should not be treated as the ordinary sword sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel kept from being milked so that she may become fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of a camel deliberately withheld from milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who commits adultery or fornication with a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical definition is reported without restriction on whether the woman is free or enslaved.
